description: This Java interface defines the OrderService with methods for managing orders, calculating totals, generating invoices, and handling order status and download files within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Interface for order-related operations in an e-commerce system, including order management, total calculations, invoice generation, and status handling.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a status history record to an order.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total order amount based on order summary, customer, store, and language.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total price of items in a shopping cart for a specific customer, store, and language.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Generates a PDF invoice for an order.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all orders associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists orders for a store based on specific criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new order or updates an existing one.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order with customer info, items, summary, payment, and store details.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order with customer info, items, summary, payment, transaction, and store details.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks if an order has downloadable files.
